title.narrative: Shimla-Himachal Pradesh Water Supply and Sewerage Services Improvement Program (PforR)

description.narrative: The PDO is to strengthen the operational and financial performance of the SJPNL Utility and improve access to water supply and sewerage services in Shimla City.

The development objective of the Shimla-Himachal Pradesh Water Supply and Sewerage Services Improvement Program for Results (PforR) Project for India is to strengthen the operational and financial performance of the Shimla Jal Prabandhan Nigam Limited (SJPNL) utility and improve access to water supply and sewerage services in Shimla city. The PforR will support a well-defined program that forms part of the Government of Himachal Pradesh (GoHP's) overarching water supply and sewerage (WSS) medium term program (MTP). The PforR program is organized in three results areas (RA): (a) improved governance, managerial, and financial autonomy; (b) improved efficiency, financial sustainability, and customer accountability; and (c) improved water supply and sewerage services.

title.narrative: SJPNL strengthened as an autonomous WSS Company

target.value: All financial and managerial decisions taken by the BoD

comment.narrative: The SJPNL Board of Directors or the MD cum CEO takes all managerial and financial decisions. (a) Managerial decisions pertain to all project management decisions, operational decisions, procurement decisions and HR policy decisions. (b) Financial decisions pertain to all financial management decisions and commercial decisions related to billing and collection, apart from tariff.

actual.value: All financial and managerial decisions taken by the BoD

title.narrative: Number of people benefitting from improved WSS services

comment.narrative:
This refers to the number of people benefiting from improved WSS services. This comprises of the following categories – (a) Residential population, and (b) Tourist population.
Improved WSS service refers to (a) Provision of continuous water supply, and (b) Provision of functional sewerage connections.
(a) Provision of continuous water supply refers to a water supply connection providing water supply for at least 20 hours a day, for a minimum of 330 days in the year. This would also apply to new connections providing at least 30 days of continuous water supply.
(b) Provision of a functional sewerage connections refers to a sewerage connection which is connected to a sewerage network.

title.narrative: SJPNL achieves operational efficiency and financial sustainability

comment.narrative: The operational efficiency refers to energy efficiency improvement, NRW reduction and improvement in O&M cost recovery (see sub-indicators).

title.narrative: (i) Number of people having access to continuous water supply

comment.narrative: Corresponds to the 2000 24X7 water supply connections provided in the demo zones.

title.narrative: (ii) Number of additional people provided with sewerage services.

comment.narrative: Corresponds to the 8,250 additional sewerage connections provided under the project. Of this, 5,881 connections have been verified by the IVA
